sentences.text: Scientists have identified a new genus and species named Hintighernia edingerae.
This dinosaur belongs to the family Tapejaridae, a group of flying reptiles.
Pêgas and colleagues described this animal from fossils found in the United Kingdom within the Cambridge Greensand.
The holotype, the specimen the species is based on, is a partial cranium previously known as Ornithostoma sedgwicki.
Micro-CT scanning reveals that the braincase anatomy of Hintighernia closely matches that of Tapejara wellnhoferi.
Hintighernia lived during the Cretaceous period.

While Ornithostoma sedgwicki was once thought to be a chaoyangopterid azhdarchoid known only from four jaw fragments, researchers now suggest a third azhdarchoid species exists in the Cambridge Greensand based on jaw and cervical remains.
